scripts.build: npm run content && npm run build:site
scripts.build:site: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --config vite.trainee.config.ts && node scripts/site-content.js copy-images && node scripts/copy-spa-404.js && npm run routes:manifest && node scripts/generate-static-routes.js && node scripts/prerender-static-html.js
scripts.build:only: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --config vite.trainee.config.ts && node scripts/site-content.js copy-images && node scripts/copy-spa-404.js
scripts.seo:weekly: npm run seo:collect && npm run seo:snapshot && npm run seo:evaluate
scripts.lighthouse: npm ci --prefix tools/lhci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && tools/lhci/node_modules/.bin/lhci collect --config=lighthouserc.mobile.json && tools/lhci/node_modules/.bin/lhci assert --config=lighthouserc.mobile.json && tools/lhci/node_modules/.bin/lhci collect --config=lighthouserc.desktop.json && tools/lhci/node_modules/.bin/lhci assert --config=lighthouserc.desktop.json
